title: Weeping Eye Orb
description: A large transparent spherical orb rests on a golden pedestal in the rain. Inside the orb a surreal scene shows a vibrant green and blue human eye with colorful lightning-like energy streams flowing downward from the pupil, merging into a swirling pool of pink, purple and yellow light at the base. Raindrops cover the orb's surface while liquid drips from the eye and the sphere.
prompt: surreal digital painting of a large transparent crystal sphere on a golden pedestal during heavy rain, inside the sphere a giant detailed human eye with bright green iris and blue pupil, colorful pink yellow and blue lightning energy flows from the eye down into a swirling glowing pool of liquid light at the bottom, raindrops and dripping paint on the surface, dramatic moody atmosphere, intricate details
